AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[ClosePanelTooltip]: Close the Advanced Road Naming panel.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[UndoWaypointToolti: Remove the most recently placed waypoint.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[ClearTooltip]: Clear the current road selection and input.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[ApplyTooltip]: Apply the current road naming operation to the selected route.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[PrefixDescriptionM: Motorway / Highway - Carries the most traffic in your city. High-speed, limited-access roads.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[PrefixDescriptionA: A-Road - Major arterial road connecting districts and suburbs. High traffic volume.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[PrefixDescriptionB: B-Road - Secondary road serving as an alternative to A-roads. Moderate traffic volume.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[PrefixDescriptionC: C-Road - Minor road connecting smaller points of interest. Low to moderate traffic.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[PrefixDescriptionI: Interstate Highway - Part of the American Interstate Highway System.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[CustomPrefixToolti: Use a custom route prefix that you type yourself.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[PositionBeforeTool: Show the route number before the road name, for example M1 - Northern Hwy.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[PositionAfterToolt: Show the route number after the road name, for example Northern Hwy - M1.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[AutoRouteNumberToo: Pick the next available route number for the selected prefix.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[RouteShieldTooltip: Choose the in-world route shield style for this saved route.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[RouteStatisticsLoa: Loading route statistics... If this takes a long time, reopen the panel.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[RouteStatisticsNoV: No valid road segments are available for this route.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[RouteStatisticsExc: {EXCLUDED} of {TOTAL} stored road segments could not be included.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[RouteStatisticsUna: Route statistics are unavailable for this game version.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[RouteStatisticsBus: Average of the high-volume percentile route segments
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[RouteStatisticsCor: Sums activity across all route segments. Vehicles travelling through several segments contribute to each segment they cross.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[RouteStatisticsVol: Weights each segment's traffic flow by its traffic volume, so the busiest parts of the route have the greatest influence.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[RouteStatisticsBot: Shows the lowest traffic flow among the route's busiest share of segments.
AdvancedRoadNaming.UI[RouteStatisticsCon: Shows the percentage of the route's road length below the configured traffic-flow threshold.
